Title: Does Psychophagia benefits from Hungry Coyote?

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
As the wording from Psychophagia says "Gain 3 blood" instead of Hunt at +2 hunt does Psychophagia benefits from hunt bonus or is a plain "Gain 3 blood" effect.?

Thanks.

Name: Psychophagia
[NB3:PH2]
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Hecata
+1 stealth hunt action.
Remove an ally in any Methuselah's ash heap from the game to gain 3 blood or to gain 2 blood and unlock.
Artist: Mark Kelly

Name: The Hungry Coyote
[Sabbat:R, SW:R, Third:R, SP:LB1, SV5:PCathari1]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique location.
Sabbat vampires you control get +1 hunt.
Artist: Mike Dringenberg

Messages.Author: Ratadin
Messages.Body: Why? I get there is a RTR that kind of specify this, but how does one understand this from card text and rulebook? Some cards say +x hunt, others say gain X, and the rulebook doesnt explain what the hunt amount is used for except in the basic hunt action effect, so there is no way to explain this except by reading specific rulings. For old cards this is understandable, but being a new card it makes no sense for this to allow +hunt effects to improve it.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: Because we didn't catch it in playtest. It should be templated in the new way, but was not.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Ratadin wrote:
> Why? I get there is a RTR that kind of specify this, but how does one understand this from card text and rulebook? Some cards say +x hunt, others say gain X, and the rulebook doesnt explain what the hunt amount is used for except in the basic hunt action effect
>
The hunt amount is used to know how much blood you gain from a hunt: "The acting vampire gains an amount of blood counters from the blood bank equal to the hunt amount."

> Ratadin wrote:
> , so there is no way to explain this except by reading specific rulings. For old cards this is understandable, but being a new card it makes no sense for this to allow +hunt effects to improve it.
>
Pyschophagia should follow the new template as Karl pointed out.

Currently, the explanation is that the base hunt amount provided by the card is 2 or 3, then it is modified by the hunt modifier.

This is similar to a Call the Great Beast having a base strength of 4 and getting +2 strength from another card to get +6 strength for instance.

Prince of Paris, France
